FAQ

Common Questions

Why does my business need a website?
+

In today's digital-first world, your website is your 24/7 salesperson. Over 80% of consumers research businesses online before making a purchase decision. Without a professional website, you're invisible to this majority. A well-built website builds credibility, showcases your work, captures leads, and converts visitors into clients — even while you sleep.

How can digital marketing help my local business?
+

Digital marketing gives local businesses the ability to reach their ideal customers with surgical precision — targeting by location, age, interests, and behavior. For every ₹1 spent on targeted digital ads, businesses typically see ₹3-8 in return. SEO ensures you appear when people in your area search for your services, and social media keeps your brand top-of-mind with your community. The result? A consistent flow of new clients and growing revenue.

How long does website development take?
+

A standard professional website typically takes 7-14 days from start to launch, depending on the complexity and how quickly you provide content (images, text, etc.). Landing pages can be completed in 3-5 days. I work efficiently without compromising quality, keeping you updated throughout the process. Rush delivery is also available for time-sensitive projects.

Do you offer ongoing support after project completion?
+

Absolutely. I offer post-launch support and maintenance packages to ensure your website stays updated, secure, and performing optimally. For ongoing digital marketing services (ads, SEO, social media), I work on monthly retainer arrangements so we can build and scale your campaigns consistently over time. Your growth is a long-term partnership, not a one-time transaction.

What industries do you specialize in?
+

I specialize in helping Interior Designers, Dental Clinics, Salons, Healthcare Clinics, Travel Agencies, and Local Businesses. These industries benefit enormously from strong online presence and targeted lead generation — and I've developed specific strategies that work for each of them. That said, my skills translate to virtually any local business that wants to grow online.

How do I get started working with you?
+

Getting started is simple! Reach out via WhatsApp, call, or email — I'll schedule a free consultation call to understand your business, goals, and budget. From there, I'll propose a customized strategy and quote. Once approved, we kick off the project immediately. Contact me today and let's start growing your business!
